name: nessian_hornbeetle_power_three_or_itself_is_not_enough
notes: M6 mapper. Printed: 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you control another creature with power 4 or greater, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' The Hornbeetle starts with two +1/+1 counters (4/4); seat 0's other creature is a 3/3 and seat 1's 5/5 is not seat 0's. At seat 0's beginning of combat no other creature seat 0 controls has power 4 or greater (the Hornbeetle itself does not count): no counter, it stays 4/4.
